verses.text: The countenance of their faces witnesses against them, And they declare their sin like Sodom; They do not hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought evil upon themselves.
Say to the righteous that it will go well with them, For they will eat the fruit of their actions.
Woe to the wicked man! It will go badly with him; For the result of his deeds will be done to him.
